items.description: This intricately crafted necklace is adorned with swirling patterns that seem to move when observed closely. items.description: These items appear to be wrist or arm guards, sometimes etched with symbols of protection or depictions of vigilant-looking animals. items.description:
This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus; Cost 2,000 gp

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description:
This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.

items.name: Efficient Quiver
items.description: This appears to be a typical arrow container capable of holding about 20 arrows. It has three distinct portions, each with a nondimensional space allowing it to store far more than would normally be possible. The first and smallest one can contain up to 60 objects of the same general size and shape as an arrow.
